raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Delivery batch 13 (ingest 2026-01-18) sent merchant_id as 'M-0NNN' strings instead of plain integers, so the INTEGER cast in silver_transactions fails. The profile shows 80 distinct values: the 40 numeric ids 100–139 plus 40 prefixed ids up to 'M-0139'. This matches raw_merchants 100–139 exactly, so 'M-0113' is a zero-padded form of 113. Batch 14 has already reverted to the numeric format.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CASE WHEN merchant_id LIKE 'M-%' THEN CAST(substr(merchant_id, 3) AS INTEGER) ELSE CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) END AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
